key_insight: Assigning rewards to individual diffusion timesteps (stepwise credit assignment) for Flow-GRPO respects the temporal roles of early vs. late steps, improving learning signals compared to uniform final-image-only credit.
problem_solved: Uniform credit assignment across all generation steps can reward or punish intermediate actions incorrectly—especially when late steps fix earlier mistakes—hindering flow-matching models trained with GRPO from learning the correct temporal structure of image generation.
method: Introduce a stepwise credit-assignment scheme for GRPO on flow-matching diffusion models that apportions reward across timesteps according to their contribution to structure vs. detail.
Integrate per-step rewards into the GRPO optimization loop for flow-matching models, enabling more informative gradients for early (low-frequency) and late (high-frequency) generation stages.
Evaluate the modified training pipeline to show improved alignment of intermediate steps and better final sample quality (qualitative and quantitative comparisons vs. uniform credit).
impact: Provides a simple, widely applicable modification to RL-based training of generative diffusion/flow models that yields clearer learning signals, better intermediate behavior, and improved final generations—useful for practitioners tuning generation fidelity and stability.
visual_elements: Timeline diagram of diffusion steps annotated with roles: early = composition/low-frequency, late = details/high-frequency, showing where credit is assigned.
Schematic comparing uniform vs. stepwise credit assignment inside the GRPO training loop (reward flow arrows to timesteps).
Before/after image pairs or step-by-step reconstructions showing corrected vs. uncorrected intermediate errors.
Bar/line chart comparing performance metrics (e.g., fidelity, stability, convergence) for uniform vs. stepwise credit strategies.
paper_title: Stepwise Credit Assignment for GRPO on Flow-Matching Models
paper_authors: Yash Savani, Branislav Kveton, Yuchen Liu, Yilin Wang, Jing Shi
